findings.title: Resolve HF YaRN inferred attention scaling before accepting the checkpoint
findings.effect: When attention_factor is absent, the validator substitutes the native expected value. HF inference ignores a lone nondefault mscale and uses an mscale/mscale_all_dim ratio when both are present. Thus valid external HF YaRN configs are accepted even though native scales Q/K differently.
findings.reproduction: factor8, mscale1.5, no attention_factor: actual Transformers5.12.1 factor1.2079441541679836 vs native1.3119162312519754. With mscale=mscale_all_dim=1, HF1.0 vs native1.2079441541679836.
findings.suggested_scope: Compute/check the effective HF attention factor using its inference semantics, or reject unsupported mscale_all_dim and absent attention_factor combinations. Exported own configs explicitly set attention_factor and therefore do not reveal this import failure.

findings.title: Reject or implement nontruncated HF YaRN frequency ramps
findings.effect: Parsing HF parameters drops truncate:false; equality against the native config then accepts the checkpoint while the new native implementation always floors/ceils the correction range. Model weights retain different RoPE phases after initialization.
findings.reproduction: Actual HF helper with theta10000/factor8/beta32,1/original2048/head64/truncatefalse differs from accepted native inverse frequencies in12entries, max0.000530855730175972.
findings.suggested_scope: Preserve and implement the semantic option or explicitly reject truncate:false at the HF boundary. Keep a real external-HF parameter regression; own roundtrip fixtures emit the default truncation and miss this.

findings.title: Preserve the HF YaRN correction-range bound for long original contexts
findings.effect: The new native frequency implementation caps high at dim//2-1. HF caps high at dim-1 before constructing a half-dimension ramp, so high may legitimately exceed the ramp length. Newly accepted long-original-context HF YaRN configs produce different frequencies. The existing named reference shares this cap and cannot detect it.
findings.reproduction: theta10000/factor8/beta32,1/original131072/head64: native validator accepts the HF config, actual HF helper differs in9entries, max6.729824235662818e-5.
findings.suggested_scope: Align the supported frequency semantics with HF, or reject the incompatible correction range for HF initialization/export until supported. Do not silently promote the old named behavior as an independent HF oracle.

reviewed_root_fix: Export explicitly sets rope_theta=self.rope.theta; not reported again.
checked_without_finding: All current raw NativeLlamaConfig callers in this source tree use the new rope field or its default; no stale rope_theta/rope_factor caller found.
Default/linear checkpoint architecture wire keeps existing rope_theta and rope_factor keys; scaled variants add semantic mode-specific fields.
Native operator Llama3 and YaRN equations match the existing named implementation for tested default parameter ranges; default/linear arithmetic remains the same.
Frozen rotary config dataclasses and dtype/static branches are JIT-safe.
validated_limits: This review independently exercised actual HF parameter generation on CPU, not full model logits, TPU numerical parity or performance.
New tests use named operators for BF16 and native-exported HF configs for consumer roundtrips; they do not cover these external-HF option combinations.
No additional finding is based only on missing test coverage or unvalidated hardware behavior.
